S1.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
S1.scope: clip0.1/0.2/0.3 in Table1; epoch3 in Table5; existing optimizer-profile numbers in Table3. Robot/Atari experiments, not Seongsan driving.

S2.title: What Matters In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning? A Large-Scale Empirical Study
S2.scope: Tested lr{3e-5,1e-4,3e-4,...}, epoch{1,3,10}, minibatch{64,128,256}, and linear lr decay to0. The study warns about learning-rate/minibatch interactions; it does not validate these combinations for Seongsan.

S3.title: Driver Dojo: A Benchmark for Generalizable Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
S3.scope: SUMO benchmark PPO uses minibatch256. Other architecture, value-loss, action and environment choices are not imported with it.

common_protocol.purpose: First screen of PPO learning settings with reward/dynamics fixed; not a reward-design sweep

control_settings.value_loss: separate optimizer, MSE, no value clipping

common_protocol.start_method: Same actor and critic weights in all candidates and B00; fresh Adam state equally in every run

fixed_environment.lateral_motion: Original SUMO default retained; original TraCI lane request persistence3s

fixed_reward.scope: Existing Seongsan reward combination with local subtask bonuses; not a complete paper reward

proposed_budget.source: Reuse of prior continuation experiment budget; local experiment management, not paper optimality

proposed_training_repeats.scope: Local existing seed labels; papers motivate repeated training, not these seed numbers or a universal adequate sample count

evaluation.scope: Existing development sets for screening; separate previously unused scenarios required for final model selection/generalization
evaluation.selection_rule: Report safety tradeoffs; do not rank by reward scale or one best seed alone

common_protocol.local_lr_schedule_for_C03: lr = 3e-4 * max(0, 1-(steps-start_steps)/additional_steps_requested); no simultaneous clip decay

priority_basis: C01/C06/C04 first: a hypothesis-driven check of less disruptive continued updates, not a proven ranking
limits: Most source sweeps are continuous-control/robotics or Atari; values are transferable search candidates, not validated Seongsan settings
Single-factor screening can miss interactions; C09/C10 are local combination candidates, and further joint tuning may be necessary
Current observation/control/rule-check consistency issues are not resolved merely by choosing these settings
selection_rule: Nearest untried combinations in the fixed literature-backed grid, not a claim of optimal settings
